easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
When you draw a card, Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2 until you have 5 life.
In response to the next trigger, cast Courageous Resolve by paying {2}{W}, giving a creature you control protection from your opponents until end of turn, drawing a card, and preventing yourself from losing the game this turn.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 until your library is empty.
